revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - The new reading is suggested without proper argument, which places it in the apparatus rather than in the main text => <:[.2]λ̣ης=BL 1.169||ed||[αὐ]λ̣ῆς=S. Strassi, Historikà 8 (2018) 380|[δο]χῆς:> || lin18 bgu 3 p.5 => BL 1.169

Submit - Line 8: added the supplement proposed by S. Strassi, "Lettere private dall’Egitto romano: documenti e contesti. A proposito di BGU III 815", Historikà 8 (2018), 375-88 (https://journals.openedition.org/historika/321). Meanwhile, corrected [δο]χῆσ -> [δο]χῆς.
Finalized - Ready. Claytor's reading is, of course, absolutely clear.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - The text now matches the ed. pr., but the papyrus has rather Ἡρα|κλῆν

General - The ed.pr. (https://archive.org/details/aegyptischeurkun312kn/page/n269/mode/2up) certainly has Ηρακ|λήν, but on the image there seems to be more ink at the beginning of line 13 than can be easily accounted by when reading |λήν.
Submit - Changed Ηρακ|κλήν to Ηρακ|λήν (lines 12-13) as it differs from the official edition of BGU 3 815 (p. 131)
